blocks.raw: ## End of Year Code Freeze
blocks.text: End of Year Code Freeze

blocks.raw: Please note that between Noon on the 21st of December to 3rd of January there will be a Modulr wide code freeze, applying to all changes, with the exception to any emergency hot fixes needed in production as part of our incident management processes.

blocks.raw: ## Modulr Mobile Approvals App
blocks.text: Modulr Mobile Approvals App

blocks.raw: We’re excited to launch our mobile experience for managing approvals. The Modulr Mobile Approvals App is a companion to the Modulr Portal that streamlines the approvals process. You'll receive real-time push notifications when you have payments or payment batches ready to approve, and can approve them directly on your device. (iOS and Android phones and tablets).
blocks.text: We’re excited to launch our mobile experience for managing approvals. The Modulr Mobile Approvals App is a companion to the Modulr Portal that streamlines the approvals process. You'll receive real-time push notifications when you have payments or payment batches ready to approve, and can approve them directly on your device. (iOS and Android phones and tablets).

blocks.raw: Key features:
blocks.text: Key features:

blocks.raw:
* Push notifications for instant approval attention
* Biometric security
* Approve single or batch payments
* View your clients' accounts and balances
blocks.text: Push notifications for instant approval attentionBiometric securityApprove single or batch paymentsView your clients' accounts and balances

blocks.raw: Continue to use the Modulr Portal for making payments, managing users, viewing transactions and all other features.
blocks.text: Continue to use the Modulr Portal for making payments, managing users, viewing transactions and all other features.

blocks.raw: Find more information on the [readme page.](https://modulr.readme.io/docs/mobile-app)

blocks.raw: # Minor Enhancements & Bugs Resolved
blocks.text: Minor Enhancements & Bugs Resolved

blocks.raw: ### Faster Payments | Blocking Payment Reference Profanities
blocks.text: Faster Payments | Blocking Payment Reference Profanities

blocks.raw: In line with new Pay.UK guidance, we will be blocking all Faster Payments that contain a profanity in the end to end reference (field 120). The payment will enter a failed state with the string saying “profanity included in reference”.
blocks.text: In line with new Pay.UK guidance, we will be blocking all Faster Payments that contain a profanity in the end to end reference (field 120). The payment will enter a failed state with the string saying “profanity included in reference”.

blocks.raw: As of the 1st January 2024, the following outbound payment types will be blocked if a profanity is included; BACS, Swift Outbound and Faster Payments.
blocks.text: As of the 1st January 2024, the following outbound payment types will be blocked if a profanity is included; BACS, Swift Outbound and Faster Payments.

blocks.raw: You can find more information about Outbound payments [here](https://modulr.readme.io/docs/outbound-payments).
blocks.text: You can find more information about Outbound payments here.

blocks.raw: ### CHAPS | Sending a CHAPS Payment To Accounts That Are Not FPS-enabled
blocks.text: CHAPS | Sending a CHAPS Payment To Accounts That Are Not FPS-enabled

blocks.raw: Outbound Faster Payments that are greater than £10,000, submitted to a payee sort code which is not Faster Payments enabled, will now be sent via CHAPS.
blocks.text: Outbound Faster Payments that are greater than £10,000, submitted to a payee sort code which is not Faster Payments enabled, will now be sent via CHAPS.

blocks.raw: The change will be effective as of the 1st January 2024.
blocks.text: The change will be effective as of the 1st January 2024.
